rows: $\mathbf p=m\mathbf v$; $P_x=\sum m_iv_{ix}$. Units kg m/s. Common inertial frame; signed components.
$J_x=\overline F_x\Delta t=\Delta p_x$. Units N s = kg m/s. Same interval; constant mass for $\Delta p_x=m(v_x-u_x)$.
$P_{fx}-P_{ix}=J_{\mathrm{ext},x}$. Fixed matter; internal impulses cancel. Negligible external impulse gives approximate conservation.
$v=\frac{m_Au_A+m_Bu_B}{m_A+m_B}$. Positive masses; common final velocity; negligible external impulse. All velocities signed.
Momentum alone cannot determine two unknown final velocities. Elastic: total $K$ unchanged. Sticking generally reduces $K$; total energy is not destroyed.
$W=\mathbf F\cdot\mathbf s=Fs\cos\theta$; $W=F_xs_x+F_ys_y$. $\theta$: angle between vectors. J = N m. Particle model; constant force vector.
$K=\frac12mv^2\geq0$; $W_{\mathrm{net}}=K_f-K_i$. Add all force works. $v=\sqrt{2K_f/m}$ gives speed, not direction.
Zero displacement or perpendicular force gives zero work. Zero net work can also mean cancellation of nonzero contributions.
$\Delta U_g=mg(h_f-h_i)=-W_g$; $U_g=mgh$ for chosen zero. Heights vertical; constant $g$. Energy belongs to Earth–object interaction.
$E_{\mathrm{mech}}=K+U_g$; $\Delta E_{\mathrm{mech}}=W_{\mathrm{other}}$. Do not count $W_g$ again. Conserved only if other net work vanishes.
$K_f=K_i+mg(h_i-h_f)+W_{\mathrm{in}}-E_d$. $E_d\geq0$: dissipated amount. Do not also subtract the same friction work. Units J.
$K_f<0$ rejects the stated endpoint. $K_f\geq0$ alone does not check barriers, contact or travel time. Numerical agreement is not experimental validation.
Force/acceleration: Newton. Force/time: impulse. Force/displacement: work. Collision then climb: separate intervals and assumptions.
